course.title: Resettlement Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
Compose a framework integrating the prospectus of the iRR (Impoverishment (15)   
Risk and Reconstruction) model and the principles of Resettlement   
Economics taking into consideration the limitations of Acquisition and   
Requisition of Immovable Property Ordinance, 1982.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
